method: Exact Moller-Trumbore ray casting from every sampled surface triangle along its inward normal, accelerated by a uniform triangle grid, for wall thickness (a voxel fallback reports its cell size above 150k triangles); face-normal angles for FDM overhang and cast draft; limits from physics/dfm_rules.py (AWS D1.1 Table 7.7, DIN 338 / ISO 235 series, workshop guidelines marked as such)

wall.method: exact ray-triangle intersection (Moller-Trumbore) from the surface along its inward normal, accelerated by a uniform triangle grid; the value is as accurate as the mesh

findings.source: Machining guideline for thin walls: 0.8 mm aluminium/steel, 1.0 mm stainless/titanium. No table or clause in a standard was found for these numbers, so it is a guideline.
findings.message: measured 5th-percentile wall 40 mm (resolution 0.0001 mm) >= 0.8 mm for cnc steel

findings.source: DIN 338:2006-09 / ISO 235 twist-drill diameter series (the diameters the standard series offers). The list above is that series; the rule that a hole outside it needs reaming or milling is a design guideline built on the series.

warnings: overhang: overhang is an FDM rule; this part is not FDM
support: support is an FDM rule; this part is not FDM
draft: draft is a casting rule; this part is not cast
undercuts: undercuts need the solid and the tool approach; they are not measurable from a triangle mesh alone
inside corner radius: the inside corner radius would have to be recognised in the mesh; the sketch that made it is not sent here
limitations: wall thickness comes from an exact ray-triangle cast, so it is as accurate as the mesh; a wall the ray leaves through an opening in an unclosed mesh cannot be measured and is counted as unresolved, never reported as a thick wall
above 150k triangles the voxel fallback is used and reports its cell as resolution_mm; a limit finer than a quarter of that cell is not_checked instead of pass/fail
holes, undercuts, tool access and inside corner radius are not recognised in a triangle mesh; holes are only checked when the caller declares them
overhang and draft limits are workshop guidelines, not clauses in a standard, so they are warnings
the wall minimum for cnc, fdm, sls, sheet and cast is a guideline (unverified source); only the weld fillet leg and the drill series are quoted from a standard
no cost, no cycle time, no tolerance stack-up
